question: Can existing independent physical decision components be exposed as legal proposal units without adding model freedom or falsely calling it a novel operator?
scope: Ordinary isolated PA adaptation support, not final four-role/QGS/shared algorithm and not revival of stopped learned-tree qualification
unchanged: old job-block moves and missing-factory paid fallback
strict RunContext and common external archive

basis.TYPED: Original2N-1jobsets plus4Ntyped single-job terms: RESOURCE_BUNDLE(FMW only),MACHINE,WORKER,ORDER_KEY;6N-1terms total
basis.SHAM_BLOCK: Same6N-1terms and per-term donor compatibility/RNG construction asTYPED, but additional terms copy the whole job(FMW+key); controls added visits rather than independent fields

donors.oldJobsetsAndResourceBundle: Uniform live nonself donor, unchanged construction; missing factory produces paid parent fallback
donors.machineWorkerAndOrderTerms: Uniform live nonself donor with same active factory for that job, in bothTYPEDandSHAM; static legality conditioning only, no objective ranking
donors.noCompatibleDonor: Paid unchanged parent attempt, no free resampling

variableChecks: MA term changes only that job's machine; WA term only worker; key term changes no resource
resource bundle copies complete legalFMW but leaves keys
job-block OFF matches frozen paid genomes/objectives
no out-of-range or cross-factory ids, no hidden repair
new same-factory marginal combinations can be produced; acceptance/reachability not assumed
fixtures: Each of two existing instances:100paid source initials plus16deterministic proposals per new term kind,164FE each;128typed proposal full/incremental timeline checks separately counted

completeRuns.note: Two complete generations per basis, engineering only; different FE across ATOM and others is not a performance comparison

cutoffs.check: Each exact prefix matches its own complete engineering trajectory

accounting: All attempts/duplicates/fallbacks paid; full QA separate. Independent reconstruction of donor eligibility, masks, original accepts, archive and paid sequence; class/source identity frozen
performanceDecision: None from engineering. Only after correctness, separately preregister equal-FE and true-time new-seed study with all3indicators and strong controls. No thresholds chosen from these fixtures
limits: Conditional product still misses some initial marginal values. Legal resource support is not a proof of complete genotype reachability or performance. No new sharing selector, mutation rate, learned feature or default mainline change
